'''Trad''' was one of [[Satele Shan]]'s [[Satele Shan's followers|students]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Echoes" /> In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Shan and her students, including Trad, were all infected by [[Tenebrae]]'s [[Tenebrae's curse|curse]] and held within a massive [[Kira Carsen's ship|ship]] by [[Kira Carsen]] and [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]]. Most of them were [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|released]] by the [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] who ended Tenebrae for good.<ref name="Echoes" /> However, Trad did not survive the ordeal and Trad's loss was mourned by Shan and the rest of her students.<ref name="Trad">{{TORcite|type=message|An update.|Satele Shan}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trad first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' as part of the "Echos of Oblivion" mission, where the student's name was first revealed by Kira Carsen.<ref name="Echoes" />
